Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in applying non-destructive angle-resolved XPS to depth-profile the solid–electrolyte interphase in Li-metal batteries, avoiding sputtering damage. Its significance: reveals depth-resolved compositional differences before and after Li plating, and links interphase thickness/distribution across electrolyte classes to protective properties and battery performance, benchmarking a non-destructive approach for understanding and improving Li-metal battery lifetime.

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Defect-modulated asymmetric Zn-N4 single-atom sites in carbon cathodes enable dual interfacial regulation: downshifted Zn d-band and nonbonding N/C 2p states accelerate Zn2+ desolvation, while enhanced electron delocalization boosts double-layer capacitance. This yields 201.5 mAh g−1, 146.5 Wh kg−1, 56% retention at 100 A g−1, and 92.1% over 110,000 cycles, establishing asymmetric single-atom coordination as a design strategy for high-rate aqueous storage.

این مقاله با اتصال عرضی کاربنی پلی‌ایمید فلورینه، فیلم دی‌الکتریک مقاوم حرارتی با چگالی انرژی ۴.۴ J cm−3 در ۲۵۰ درجه سانتی‌گراد می‌سازد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a carbene-mediated C–H insertion cross-linking strategy using stepwise thermal activation, enabling efficient cross-linking (95.8% at 2 wt.% BLD201) of aromatic polymers lacking reactive groups. Its significance is transforming commercial fluorinated polyimide into free-standing films with outstanding capacitive energy storage at 250°C (4.4 J cm⁻³), offering a versatile route to thermally resilient dielectric materials.
🏷 carbene cross-linking · dielectric polymer · capacitive energy storage · fluorinated polyimide · high-temperature capacitor

item.title: High‐Entropy Materials as a Design Paradigm for Low‐Temperature Sodium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
این مرور نشان می‌دهد مهندسی آنتروپی در مواد آنتروپی‌بالا با ایجاد بی‌نظمی پیکربندی، انتقال Na+ و پایداری فاز و سینتیک بین‌سطحی را در باتری‌های سدیم-یون دمای پایین بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Materials | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely positions high-entropy materials as a design paradigm for low-temperature sodium-ion batteries, linking configurational disorder to transport, phase stability, and interfacial kinetics across cathodes, anodes, electrolytes, and interfaces. Its significance lies in proposing quantitative descriptors, minimum reporting metrics, and a unifying entropy–percolation framework, while outlining trade-offs and manufacturability constraints needed to translate entropy engineering into robust low-temperature operation.

💡 The novelty lies in an industry-scalable roll-to-roll Al₂O₃ coating on PET substrates that acts as a physical barrier against electrolyte attack. item.title: Disordered Nanodomains Stabilize Near-Degeneracy in Complex Layered Oxides
item.description:

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in engineering disordered nanodomains to stabilize near-degenerate states in layered oxides, preventing irreversible phase transformations during lithium intercalation. This significantly advances understanding of structural stability in complex oxides and offers a pathway to overcome capacity and longevity limits in lithium-ion batteries, enabling higher-performance cathode materials.
🏷 layered oxides · lithium intercalation · disordered nanodomains · phase transformation · cathode stability
